text: The best option for fixing the flood culvert is the box culvert sized for the century storm. This solution is designed to provide the highest level of reliability and capacity to handle significant flooding events. The cost savings achieved through this option will also help reduce the burden on the community's finances while ensuring the culvert remains functional and safe for years to come. Committing to this approach will prioritize the village's long-term flood mitigation needs while also maintaining a cost-effective solution.
